title: Bitwise OR of All Subsequence Sums
summary: Given an integer array, compute the bitwise OR of the sums of all possible subsequences within the array.
statement: Given an integer array, compute the bitwise OR of the sums of all possible subsequences within the array.
constraints: Consider every subsequence, including the empty one, and compute its element sum.
hints: Count how many input values contribute a one at each bit position.
Any positive count makes that bit appear in some subsequence sum.
Pairs of contributions at one bit create carries into the next bit; propagate count//2 upward.
Choosing suitable subsets realizes both each present bit and every propagated binary carry, so marking all nonzero levels gives exactly the OR of all sums.

tests.explanation: Possible sums expose bits 0, 1, and 2, so their bitwise OR is seven.
Subsequence sums include four and eight, exposing bits two and three for result twelve.
